raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 31 raw_transactions rows with status 'REVERSAL' carry orig_txn_id pointing at POSTED originals (e.g. 904133 is POSTED in batch 13). silver_transactions filters only on status='POSTED', so those originals are counted while their reversals are dropped, which inflates recent-day gold totals. Excluding POSTED rows that have a matching REVERSAL row should net them out.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id);"}}
